title: Glasgow 2026: Ghana’s 4x100m relay team through to final
desc: Ghana’s 4x100m men’s relay team booked their spot in the final of the 2026 Commonwealth Games after running a blistering 38.40 seconds to finish second in heat two on Saturday morning.

title: Atiku to Obasanjo: I’ve no apology for opposing your third-term agenda
desc: Former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar has told ex-President Olusegun Obasanjo that he has no apology for standing against his third-term agenda during their days in office.

title: Many French return home after wildfires, but new blazes pop up
desc: Firefighters have contained a vast wildfire in southwestern France, allowing nearly 200,000 people to return home.

title: Judoka Amir lands historic gold for Malaysia at C'wealth Games
desc: PETALING JAYA: Amir Daniel Abdul Majeed scored a historic first for Malaysia in judo after winning the men's below 81kg category at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games on Aug 1 (Saturday).

title: Autonomous Key reduces app distractions with an NFC lock
desc: Autonomous Key is a $9 NFC physical key and companion app that blocks distracting apps for up to 60 minutes per unlock, offers AI usage reports, cross-device support, and no subscription fees.

title: Compression wraps offer no healing advantage for venous leg ulcers, clinical trial finds
desc: Compression wraps are unlikely to help venous leg ulcers heal faster than standard compression treatments, according to a clinical trial led by University of Manchester and York researchers.

desc: The horizontal handheld will be released in navy and orange colorways.

title: Boy George parts ways with "gutless" record label manager who refused to release pro-Israel song
desc: Boy George has parted ways with his record label manager after he refused to release the singer's pro-Israel song 'We Will Dance Again'.
